settings.name: claude_key
settings.title: Claude API key
settings.about: A Claude API key, from console.anthropic.com. One key is enough.

settings.name: openai_key
settings.title: ChatGPT API key
settings.about: A ChatGPT (OpenAI) API key, from platform.openai.com. One key is enough.

settings.name: openrouter_key
settings.title: OpenRouter key
settings.about: An OpenRouter key, from openrouter.ai/keys. One key is enough.

settings.name: url
settings.title: Another service
settings.about: Any other service that answers the way OpenAI does, up to /v1, like http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama, with the ChatGPT key when it needs one. With service claude, where Claude is reached instead, up to /v1.

settings.name: service
settings.title: Service
settings.about: claude, chatgpt or openrouter, when you keep more than one key. Else the first of those it has.

settings.name: model
settings.title: Model
settings.about: The model to use. Else claude-opus-5-5, gpt-5-mini or openai/gpt-5-mini, for the service it uses.
